remarks: Looking for a furnished spot to rent for a short term option? This fully furnished one-bedroom coastal retreat, offering picturesque views of Long Island Sound, is tucked within the coveted Bell Island community. Light-filled and inviting, this charming cottage blends character and convenience, making it the perfect year-round residence or weekend escape. The spacious, open layout features a full kitchen, comfortable living area, and thoughtfully designed interiors for easy living and entertaining. Step outside to breathe in the salt air, soak in the water vistas, or enjoy access to private beaches and scenic walkways just moments away. Additional highlights laundry, tasteful furnishings, and all the comforts of home. Move right in and experience the relaxed elegance of coastal living-this Bell Island gem is not to be missed.
